data.name: Uriah
data.gender_notes: Uriah is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Uriah means 'light of God' in Hebrew. In the Bible, Uriah was a Hittite soldier who was a mighty warrior and a man of great faith. He was loyal to King David and was slain by the king's order, after which his wife Bathsheba married David. The name Uriah carries the meaning “Light of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Uriah usually hope their child will grow to embody light of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength and faith in the presence of adversity.
data.etymology: Uriah belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Uriah total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_hebrew.name: אוריה
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים הוא האור שלי, אור האלוהים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אוריה הוא שילוב של שני מילים עבריות: 'אור' שפירושו אור, וא 'יה' שפירושו אלוהים. לפיכך, ניתן לפרש את השם אוריה כ 'אלוהים הוא האור שלי' או 'אור האלוהים'. השם אוריה מוזכר במקרא כבן של חירם המלך וגם כאחד מהחשובים במלכות יהודה.

in_greek.name: Οὐρίας
in_greek.meaning: Θεός είναι το φως μου, Ο Θεός είναι το φως
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο 이름 Οὐρίας προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι το φως μου' ή 'Το φως του Θεού'. Ο Οὐρίας ήταν ένας από τους πιστούς του Θεού στην Παλαιά Διαθήκη και αναφέρεται στο βιβλίο του Βασιλέων.

in_latin.name: Uriah
in_latin.meaning: Deus est lux mea, Lux Dei
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Uriah derivatur ex lingua hebraica et significat 'Deus est lux mea' vel 'Lux Dei'. Uriah fuit fidelis Dei in Veteri Testamento et commemoratur in libro Regum.
